title: Being a Maya Scribe
hook: The few who knew how to paint the gods' words.

scenes.text: In ancient Maya city-states, literacy was an exclusive superpower reserved for elite royal scribes.
scenes.imagePrompt: Towering Mesoamerican limestone pyramid temple rising above lush tropical jungle canopy. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: You trained for decades to master hundreds of intricate phonetic glyphs painted in vivid mineral pigments.

scenes.text: Scribes ground crushed jade, hematite, and copal tree resin to create waterproof ceremonial inks.

scenes.text: Books called codices were made of folded fig-tree bark paper, documenting astronomical eclipses and dynastic wars.
